boundary: These 100 passes are distinct evidence-discovery/knowledge-model passes. A seeded pass is not a claim that the topic is saturated or that raw publisher data have been executed.

status_semantics.seeded_with_primary: Discovery has at least one peer-reviewed/primary experimental evidence anchor from this research cycle.
status_semantics.gap_seeded: The pass is explicitly opened and anchored by a broader measurement/review source; targeted primary-study saturation remains required.

passes.title: Non-return valve / check-ring wear
passes.objective: Measure closure/wear effects, shot repeatability and compensation boundaries.

passes.title: Screw wear condition monitoring
passes.objective: Relate actual flow/throughput signatures to screw wear without masking deterioration.

passes.title: Barrel wear and screw/barrel clearance
passes.objective: Find measured barrel-clearance/wear studies and quality effects.

passes.title: Plasticising torque, drive current and energy
passes.objective: Use torque/current/electrical signatures to distinguish material load from machine condition.

passes.title: Recovery stability and screw-return repeatability
passes.objective: Characterise recovery time/position repeatability and startup drift.

passes.title: Injection-axis command versus actual tracking
passes.objective: Separate commanded velocity/pressure from delivered machine motion and dynamic response.

passes.title: Nozzle pressure and nozzle-contact evidence

passes.title: Hydraulic thermal state, servo and valve response

passes.title: Cold-start, warm-equilibrium and machine fingerprint

passes.title: Cross-machine transfer and normalization

passes.title: Tie-bar load distribution

passes.title: Platen deflection and parallelism

passes.title: Toggle/direct clamp mechanical error
